::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
SMIC's Beijing expansion JV (中芯京城, 54.04% SMIC-owned), targeting 100,000 wafers/month of 12-inch, 28nm-and-above capacity in the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area.
:::

**Chinese name:** 中芯京城 (Zhōngxīn Jīngchéng)

## What does this facility make?

12-inch (300mm) wafers at 28nm and more mature nodes for foundry customers.

## Why does it matter?

Reported investment figures vary slightly by source — $7.6 billion (Yicai) and $7.7 billion / RMB 49.7 billion (CnTechPost) — likely the same commitment described at slightly different points or currency conversions; both are given here since no source explicitly reconciles them.
